name: Miyako (Fukuoka, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Miyako town emblem in light blue, red and green: light blue, red and green curved strokes, like a wing.
history: Municipal flag of Miyako, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 13 September 2012; the emblem dates from 20 March 2006.

features.role: Miyako town emblem — light blue, red and green curved strokes, like a wing
